eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Coconino, AZ; at 5:13 PM on AUG 19, 2020 Effective until 8:13 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The 911 system in Forest Lakes is currently down.  If you cannot reach 911, please go to the Forest Lakes Fire Station for assistance.  The cause and duration of this outage is not yet known.  We will advise when service is restored.
